description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

WEC Business Services LLC is seeking an Enterprise Applications Developer to design, develop, deploy, support, and maintain enterprise software solutions. The role works across web applications, databases, cloud technologies, and systems integration, including support for AI frameworks and models.
Enterprise Applications Developer architecting enterprise web solutions, administering SQL Server and Azure, and developing APIs for system integration.

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, deploy, and maintain complex web-based applications and enterprise software solutions
• Architect and implement scalable application solutions using modern development frameworks and best practices
• Administer, maintain, optimize, and integrate SQL Server databases within enterprise web applications
• Develop, deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot cloud-based solutions within Microsoft Azure environments
• Create, maintain, and monitor API endpoints to support system integration and business operations
• Lead or contribute to software development projects ranging from small enhancements to large-scale enterprise initiatives
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and leadership to gather requirements and deliver business solutions
• Perform data processing, migration, and systems maintenance activities, including support for legacy environments
• Support software deployment processes, release management, and production troubleshooting
• Develop and enforce standardized technical policies, procedures, and operational documentation
• Participate in system architecture reviews, security assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives
• Support and administer AI frameworks/models used in the software development lifecycle

Requirements:
• The applicant will have an understanding of software development across multiple platforms
• The applicant should possess a technical understanding of web applications, databases, cloud technologies, and systems integration
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Information Systems, MIS, Data Science, Information Science, Engineering is required. Other bachelor's degrees will be considered based on related IT experience. Successful completion of a certified Application Development Apprenticeship will also be considered in lieu of a bachelor's degree

Preferred:
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Knowledge of GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Microsoft SQL Server
• Strong background of AI Framework and AI Development models
• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting skills and a strong understanding of networking concepts
• Knowledge of software development life cycle, production support, application architecture, related technical roles
• Proficiency in the administration, deployment, maintenance, monitoring, and troubleshooting of Microsoft Azure, Python, Git, GitHub, Azure DevOps, Visual Studio and VSCode
• Experience leading or participating in/with development teams of various sizes and organizational structures in large-scale enterprise environments
• Knowledge of enterprise architecture, systems modernization initiatives and CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure management
• WEC Energy Group will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1 with OPT or CPT, H-1, H-2, L-1, B, J or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire
